title: In-Silico and Functional Characterization of EcdLp, an ABC Transporter of Aspergillus nidulans NRRL11440.
authors: Prakash, Shaurya; Kumar, Arvind; Kumari, Hemlata; Sinha, Minakshi; Kumar, Vinay; Kumar, Antresh
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌ABC转运蛋白EcdLp与底物Echinocandin B的分子对接及外排功能，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作建模，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法仅分子对接且无TF-DNA相关机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Echinocandin B (ECB) biosynthesis in Aspergillus nidulans is primarily governed by multiple genes located within the biosynthetic echinocandin (ecd) gene cluster. The contributory functions of many genes, including transcription factors and tailoring enzymes of the ecd gene cluster, have been previously studied. The present study focused on determining the role of transporter proteins, EcdLp, EcdCp, and EcdDp, in ECB efflux using in silico and biochemical approaches. The molecular docking analysis revealed that ECB relatively showed higher binding affinity for EcdLp than the other co-clustered MFS transporters EcdCp and EcdDp, suggesting a preferred substrate of EcdLp. These results were further confirmed by heterologous integration of the ecdL gene in the ABC transporters-deficient Saccharomyces cerevisiae AD1-8u(-), confirming active efflux. However, the binding of ECB in EcdLp is distinct from the R6G binding, overlapping the promiscuous site of farnesol, resulting in inhibition of R6G efflux in a dose-dependent manner. In conclusion, these results decipher the ECB binding and efflux mechanism and unveil the evolutionarily specialized architecture of EcdLp that permits targeted metabolite export in addition to environmental responsiveness, and lay the groundwork for optimizing ECB production via transporter engineering.
abstract_zh: 构巢曲霉（Aspergillus nidulans）中棘白菌素B（Echinocandin B, ECB）的生物合成主要受生物合成棘白菌素（ecd）基因簇内多个基因的调控。包括转录因子和ecd基因簇的修饰酶在内的许多基因的功能贡献已有先前研究。本研究聚焦于通过计算机模拟和生化方法确定转运蛋白EcdLp、EcdCp和EcdDp在ECB外排中的作用。分子对接分析显示，与其他共簇MFS转运蛋白EcdCp和EcdDp相比，ECB对EcdLp表现出相对更高的结合亲和力，表明EcdLp具有优先底物特性。这些结果通过将ecdL基因异源整合到ABC转运蛋白缺陷型酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）AD1-8u(-)中进一步得到证实，确认了其主动外排功能。然而，ECB在EcdLp中的结合与R6G结合不同，重叠于法尼醇的混杂位点，导致R6G外排以剂量依赖性方式受到抑制。总之，这些结果解析了ECB的结合与外排机制，揭示了EcdLp进化上特化的结构，该结构允许在环境响应之外实现靶向代谢物输出，并为通过转运蛋白工程优化ECB生产奠定了基础。
